subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘MORE’ is coded as ‘14 - 12 - 9 - 22’ and ‘KNOW’ is coded as ‘16 - 13 - 12 - 4’. How will ‘SAID’ be coded in the given language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘MORE’ is coded as ‘14 - 12 - 9 - 22’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9942fc7110c747bd52249cfc4bb9e017774ff51b68cefabd2099d790fffae65.png] 

And,

‘KNOW’ is coded as ‘16 - 13 - 12 - 4’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1ae879f68f9fa0b3500811bf42818e779f94fa0f3e878e66cd8944473f745a0.png] 

Similarly,

‘SAID’ is coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcdd98fe112afe2a21568d36d1ddc74399eba89962080247427012e0a27f205b.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
